evidence.claim: Defines the active initialization order from INPUT through CRACK.
Scans for INPUT and requires current type 3 before converting it to block-input mode.
Defines required/optional lookup and exact, case-sensitive matching for every requested block token.
Records the verified transition to exact SOLVER, STATISTICAL, MATERIALS, and CLUSTERS generation tokens while retaining END APPROXIMATION only as compatibility input.
Defines solver schedules and parses up to 50 current-format solver records and their options while retaining an old-format path.
Defines the case-insensitive SHEFF backend, solver, and preconditioner values accepted by the submodule revision pinned by the BSAM source commit.
Locates the optional UFUNCTIONS block and divides entries at *end records.
Normalizes each UFUNCTION entry, extracts its name and two-column numeric data, builds natural-cubic-spline coefficients, and requires strictly monotonic x coordinates.
Resolves material parameter values of the form ufunc_<name> to the first matching normalized UFUNCTION name.
Resolves interface-material parameter values of the form ufunc_<name> and binds them to UFUNCTION objects.
Parses MOISTURE key/value labels, resolves and checks its external environment, disables coupling on missing prerequisites, and executes the converter/program workflow.
Runs enabled moisture coupling at completed block-loading steps and applies the optional positive step-index filter.
Requires CLUSTERS, accepts solid finite-element cluster type 100, and delegates each cluster to the FE reader.
Contains the active first-five-character finite-element command dispatch and line-option handling.
Reads the last FILE option on *INCLUDE, increments the include unit, and prepends the original BSAM input directory when opening the target.
On included-file EOF, closes the current include unit and resumes the parent include or root FE stream.
Defines the DIMENSIONS, NODE, ELEMENT, NSET, and ELSET data-row grammars and next-command termination.
Defines nested integration-point records and nodal or elemental orientation records.
Requires one thickness/material row per declared layer, normalizes thicknesses, and applies the section to the selected element set.
Requires BOUNDARY and begins dispatch of boundary problem types and nested controls.
Defines mechanical/thermal problem starts and the active nested BOUNDARY command dispatch through convergence and output controls.
Defines penalty types -2/-21, nodal, and surface connection headers, subordinate set rows, defaults, sentinels, and cross-reference checks.
Defines static, fatigue, 2D-fatigue, reduced-fatigue, block repetition, and boundary-condition change records.
Defines D_AA, active four-character convergence labels, values, defaults, and the twelve-record scan limit.
Defines data-file, sum-force, volume-average, traction-average, and CFV output records and selectors.
Defines all/list/qualified-name selection for clusters and cluster-qualified node or element sets.
Requires CONSTITUTIVE, dispatches constitutive type records, and reads the current *MIC value array.
Locates optional TABLES and divides table entries at *end records.
Locates the optional exact STATISTICAL start token and divides entries at *end records until END STATISTICAL DISTRIBUTIONS.
Requires MATERIALS and dispatches legacy numeric and newer representations, including numeric or named Mises material type 50.
Locates optional FAILURE and dispatches failure criterion records, including interface-family types 34, 35, and 36.
Locates optional USER and begins dispatch of numeric user-function types.
Locates optional CRACK and dispatches current FE crack types 101, 201, and 301.
Current project deck assembled from pre-existing mesh data using INPUT type 3, MATERIALS, CLUSTERS, and current FE commands; VTMS may have assembled or visualized the mesh but did not generate it.
Current multi-cluster project deck assembled from pre-existing mesh data that demonstrates repeated solid cluster records; VTMS may have assembled or visualized the mesh but did not generate it.

The transformed eight-ply notch deck completed input and connection setup, produced step and TP artifacts, and ran for 120 seconds before a controlled timeout stop with exit code zero and no fatal marker.
Defines -I/-O directory flags, optional .in removal, basename handling, and output artifact stems.
Writes the explicit end-of-program timing sentinel after all boundary problems finish.
Defines .exit values 0 continue, 1 disrupt, and 2 stop.
A controlled copied deck produced a fatal missing-MATERIALS message while the Windows process returned exit code zero.
A controlled copied deck changed only MATERIAL to MATERIALS; its existing CLUSTERS and END CLUSTERS tokens were accepted, all steps completed, and the end-of-program sentinel was emitted.

parameters.summary: Selects the case-insensitive SHEFF backend; availability depends on how the executable was built.

parameters.name: solver
parameters.summary: Selects the case-insensitive SHEFF solver. The pinned dispatcher accepts the spellings gmes/fgmes, not gmres; none is PETSc-only.

parameters.name: preconditioner
parameters.summary: Selects the case-insensitive SHEFF preconditioner using the active parser label; ilu and ilut select the same ILUT category.

parameters.name: relative_tolerance
parameters.summary: Sets the SHEFF relative tolerance.

parameters.name: maximum_iterations
parameters.summary: Sets the SHEFF maximum iteration count.

parameters.name: petsc_opts
parameters.summary: Passes PETSc options to a SHEFF PETSc backend.

parameters.name: debug_opts
parameters.summary: Passes SHEFF debug flags; recognized flags include -pause, -write_sparsity, and PETSc-only -reorder and -save_to_binary.

variants.name: current-pardiso

fields.name: *type
fields.summary: Begins a PARDISO or MPI cluster-PARDISO definition.

fields.name: n_threads
fields.summary: Sets the OpenMP thread count; emit explicitly in current syntax.

fields.name: matrix_type
fields.summary: Sets the matrix classification; emit explicitly in current syntax.

cpardiso is replaced by pardiso with a warning in a non-MPI build.
Unknown option labels warn and are ignored.

The implementation accepts gmes and fgmes, while the source comment's gmres spelling is rejected.

variants.name: legacy-numeric

fields.name: n_threads
fields.summary: Sets threads for type 8 and is read as a dummy/thread value for type 9.

fields.name: marker

Type 9 is replaced by type 8 with a warning in a non-MPI build.
The notch_v1 deck uses this preserved legacy form.

top_level_blocks.summary: Defines named user functions parsed as *end-delimited entries.

parameters.name: name
parameters.summary: Names the function. Cleaning lowercases the header, and the semantic name is its last token after splitting on spaces, hyphens, and underscores; generation uses one unique token.

parameters.name: x
parameters.summary: Supplies the consumer-defined independent coordinate; all x values must be strictly monotonic in one direction.

parameters.name: y
parameters.summary: Supplies the consumer-defined function value paired with x.

variants.name: two-column-cubic-spline
variants.when: each entry starts with a function-name line

fields.name: name
fields.summary: Defines the function name used by ufunc_<name> references.

fields.name: *end
fields.summary: Terminates the entry and must be lowercase for the outer block splitter.

constraints: At least two numeric data rows are required.
Current safe generation emits exactly two columns; other column counts do not initialize the coefficients required by accessors.
x values must be distinct and strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
Blank lines and commas are normalized before numeric conversion.
Leading lines beginning with * are skipped by the initializer but have no implemented semantics and are not generated.
Duplicate normalized names are unsafe because material lookup selects the first match.

dependencies: Structured material parameters may reference a function as ufunc_<name>.
Function coordinate/value units are defined by the consuming material parameter rather than by UFUNCTIONS.

top_level_blocks.summary: Configures optional coupling to the external moisture simulation workflow.

parameters.name: program
parameters.summary: Selects the lowercased moisture executable name, resolved first through the system command lookup and then as a platform executable in the moisture directory.

parameters.summary: Selects the lowercased converter basename; the parser appends .py and requires the file in the moisture directory.

parameters.name: converter_utils
parameters.summary: Lists lowercased utility basenames; the parser appends .py and requires every file in the moisture directory.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.summary: Selects the lowercased moisture workflow directory. Safe generation uses a relative child of the input or output directory because the full-path branch is prepended with the input directory.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.summary: Selects completed block-loading step numbers at which coupling runs; omission runs at every qualifying step.

variants.name: external-moisture-workflow
variants.when: the optional MOISTURE block is present

fields.name: value
fields.summary: Sets the registered value using key = value syntax.

constraints: Generation emits one key/value pair per line even though the parser can distribute multiple keys and values around one equals sign.
Cleaning lowercases keys and values, replaces commas with spaces, removes blank lines, and compacts whitespace.
steps values must be positive because they are used as one-based array indexes.
Required environment files are <converter>.py, every <converter_utils>.py file, and mdsim.conf; the program must resolve from command lookup or the moisture directory.
Any missing directory/file/program prerequisite prints errors and disables moisture rather than stopping BSAM.
The workflow shells out to Python and the selected program, creates step directories, and moves/copies moisture outputs.
Agent execution is blocked by default until a separately trusted external-integration profile authorizes the directory, executables, scripts, and shell side effects.

dependencies: Coupling is invoked only for hygro-thermomechanical output at a completed block-loading step.
A steps list filters those invocations; no list means every qualifying step.
Execution requires the external MDSIM installation and support files and is not part of the initial notch acceptance profile.

nested_constructs.summary: Configures nonlinear convergence, time-step, iteration, and reattempt controls.

parameters.name: relative
parameters.summary: Relative convergence tolerance; may share a row with absolute and divergence.

parameters.name: absolute
parameters.summary: Absolute convergence tolerance.

parameters.name: divergence
parameters.summary: Residual divergence multiplier parsed from a relative/absolute row.

parameters.name: maxiterations
parameters.summary: Maximum nonlinear iterations; recognized by the maxi prefix.

parameters.name: mintime
parameters.summary: Minimum time control; recognized by the mint prefix.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.summary: Full stiffness-inversion interval; recognized by the inve prefix.

parameters.name: D_AA
parameters.summary: Anderson acceleration: 0 inactive, 1 prediction, 2 correction.

parameters.name: d_in
parameters.summary: Initial automatic time increment; full labels such as d_initial match this prefix.

parameters.name: it_restart
parameters.summary: Iteration interval reset control recognized by it_r.

parameters.name: d_reduction
parameters.summary: Time-increment reduction ratio recognized by d_re; a negative default disables reset.

parameters.name: d_min
parameters.summary: Minimum time increment recognized by d_mi.

parameters.name: it_opt
parameters.summary: Optimum-iteration adjustment control recognized by it_o.

parameters.name: d_max
parameters.summary: Maximum time increment recognized by d_ma.

parameters.name: fatigue
parameters.summary: 2D/3D fatigue convergence control recognized by fati.

remaining_work: Resolve safe ranges and runtime behavior for automatic increment and fatigue controls; ini_dtime and fatigue2D3DD do not receive visible defaults in this parser routine.
Runtime-probe D_AA modes and automatic time-step interactions before enabling unconstrained model-generated changes.

variants.name: tolerances
constraints: At least relative or absolute must be present on a tolerance row.
When only absolute is present, the internal relative tolerance is set to 10.

variants.name: anderson-acceleration
constraints: D_AA is found by key search before the four-character dispatch.

variants.name: scalar-control
variants.when: row begins a recognized four-character label

fields.name: value
fields.summary: Control value parsed from the second delimited token.

constraints: The parser scans at most twelve convergence records.
Long VTMS labels are accepted when their first four characters match, including d_reduction, d_min, d_max, it_opt, and it_restart.
An unrecognized record is backspaced for the enclosing BOUNDARY dispatcher rather than accepted as a convergence option.

dependencies: Convergence controls apply to the current boundary problem and its ordered loading sequence.
Automatic increment controls must be validated as a coherent group before rendering changes.

nested_constructs.summary: Defines output types and their target, coordinate-system, and intermediate-output options.

parameters.name: type
parameters.summary: Selects the output family by its first three characters.

parameters.name: c_system
parameters.summary: Selects the coordinate system; only the mate prefix changes the default.

parameters.name: intermediate
parameters.summary: Controls intermediate output frequency/selection.

remaining_work: Enumerate accepted data-file formats and runtime-verify each output family, coordinate system, and intermediate control.

variants.name: data-file
constraints: Exactly one type key may appear in a header row.
A header accepts at most five key/value pairs.

variants.name: node-set-aggregate
constraints: The selector must resolve at least one existing node set.

variants.name: element-set-aggregate
constraints: The selector must resolve at least one existing element set.
The active implementation reduces multiple selected sets to one entry per distinct cluster.

dependencies: All selected clusters and sets must belong to the current boundary problem.
Mesh, set, or cluster edits must revalidate every output selector.

transformations.summary: Expands the established notch_v1 two-ply source profile into the approved eight-ply laminate while preserving total thickness and dependent controls.

applicability.failure: The source profile must contain exactly two cluster templates.
The template clusters must be named PLY1 and PLY2.
Each notch ply template must contain 5222 explicit nodes.
Each notch ply template must contain 2502 explicit elements.
PLY1 and PLY2 node and element labels must match.
PLY1 and PLY2 element types and connectivity must match.
Both templates require XMIN, XMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX node sets.
PLY1 and PLY2 must retain constitutives 1 and 2 respectively.
The source plies must establish contiguous unit-thickness Z extents from 0 through 2.

parameters.name: output_plies
parameters.summary: The only output ply count supported by this versioned transformation.

decisions.name: boundary_policy
decisions.value: replicate in-plane controls to every ply; retain Z restraint on PLY1.ZMIN only

impacts: Replicate and rescale cluster nodes while retaining in-plane coordinates, labels, topology, sets, selections, and alternating orientations.
Replicate crack definitions for approximation IDs 1 through 8.
Render one chained penalty group with seven constitutive-3 master surfaces and PLY8 as the terminal slave.
Replicate in-plane boundary conditions and XMAX loading to every ply while keeping one bottom Z restraint.
dependencies: The complete output source set must pass semantic validation with no unresolved, ambiguous, or type-mismatched references.
The plan must be rebound to the exact source-set digest during review and apply.
The output must be written separately from the source with an immutable audit sidecar.

execution_contract.success_policy: Require the explicit end-of-program sentinel and absence of classified fatal diagnostics; process exit code alone is not authoritative.

control_files.role: Primary text listing and diagnostic stream.
Text step-progress stream; repeated step numbers are possible.
Live control file: 0 continue, 1 disrupt, 2 stop.
Text run artifact observed in successful execution.
Binary damage/history artifact observed in successful execution.
Binary MIC damage/history artifact observed in successful execution.
